# The Global Dispatch

> Independent reporting, clear context and global perspective.

The Global Dispatch is a demonstration news publication covering world affairs, politics, business, technology, courts, science, sports, culture, lifestyle and opinion.

## Important content note

All people, headlines and reporting scenarios in this starter are illustrative dummy content. They must not be treated as verified real-world reporting.

- /about

## Attribution

When citing this site, link to the canonical article URL and name the author shown on the story. Preserve any correction or update note attached to the article.

## Contact

Configure the newsroom contact address with NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL.
